title: NEW Victoria Harbour 45 minute Boat Tour with Tour Guide
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We're thrilled to partner with the Greater Victoria Harbour Authority to bring you a wonderful 45 minute cruise on our brand new sightseeing boat that was built in Canada! We cruise through Victoria's Inner Harbour, past Fisherman's Wharf and out to the cruise ship terminal. We then loop around and take you under the Johnson Street bridge and into the Gorge, before heading back to dock. You'll see and learn about many of Victoria's sights and landmarks with live commentary from our local tour guides. 

Victoria has a rich history and even if you're a local you're sure to learn something new. You're in safe hands with our Transport Canada certified captains and crew members. Enjoy snacks and drinks from your bar and make use of your washroom if the need arises. We've been running popular sightseeing boat tours in Vancouver for a few years and we're excited to expand our offering to Victoria. Customer service is always your top priority.
